about: Front JA0: findings of the ja lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile ja) that are correct Japanese in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.

map:helpMenu.websitesNote.reason: "Observatories" is in the English proper name NASA Astronomical Virtual Observatories, kept as written beside NAVO

original:\" Not Found..reason: VIREO joins this piece after a name it opens with an untranslated straight ", so the closing mark must stay a straight quote, as in pt, fr, hi and ru

original:fragment|You have not recorded.reason: VIREO closes this straight quote itself in a piece it never translates, so the opening mark must stay a straight quote, as in pt, fr, hi and ru

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: Japanese puts the diameter inside the name («{diameter}メートル電波望遠鏡»), as es, pt, fr and ru do

original:Object: (.reason: VIREO closes this ASCII parenthesis itself after the selection number («天体：(3) M45»), so the opening one stays ASCII (ja.test.ts ASCII_BRACKET_PIECES)

original:Ok.reason: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it (VIREO wrote this button Ok)

original:to.reason: the en dash Japanese writes between the two ends of a range («1h 2m 3s –4h 5m 6s»; plan §4.1: no wave dash); VIREO joins it between two coordinates

map:camera.citationIr.reason: a bibliographic citation: the survey's published name (Two Micron All Sky Survey) and authors stay as published

catalog:multispec.fieldInternal.reason: "trying again will not help" is the verb, not Help (ヘルプ)

catalog:instrumentParameters.spectromete.reason: "signal-to-noise" is S/N比, the glossary's term for the ratio

catalog:pleiadesPoint.help.reason: "counts" is the verb (is accepted: 対象になります), not detector counts

map:observatory.entry.help.reason: "counts as north" is the verb (is treated as: 扱われます), not detector counts

map:observatory.entry.adaptation.reason: VIREO's own kind words (Star/Galaxy/QSO) as the HTL file writes them in Comments, kept as written

map:polish.pulsarsHtl.button.reason: the bundled file name Pulsars.HTL, kept as written

map:polish.pulsarsHtl.error.reason: the bundled file name Pulsars.HTL, kept as written

original:pointStyle|Open.reason: a plot point style (open circle, 白抜き), not the Open command (開く)

original:Set Date/Time, ID.reason: VIREO's item sets both the date/time and the ID (日時とIDを設定), one verb for the two

original:Set E(B-V) to correct value for.reason: VIREO's hint asks for the correct value: «E(B-V)を正しい値に設定» (the item Set E(B-V) is «E(B-V)を設定»)

original:Signal to Noise Ratio:.reason: signal-to-noise is S/N比, the glossary's term for the ratio (both VIREO labels show the ratio)

original:Signal/Noise:.reason: signal-to-noise is S/N比, the glossary's term for the ratio (both VIREO labels show the ratio)
